text:
AT&T Stadium wɔ Arlington, Texas, kurow a ne nnipa bɛyɛ 390,000 a ɛda Dallas ne Fort Worth ntam. Wɔde too hɔ wɔ 1884, na metroplex no kurow a ɛdi kan, Dallas, hyɛɛ ase wɔ 1841. Wɔbom yɛ Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex no mfinimfini, ɔman mu metropolitan areas a ɛso wɔ United States mu wɔ nnipa bɛboro 7 million.

Arlington ayɛ metroplex no mu sports ne entertainment hub. AT&T Stadium nkyɛn no, kurow no wɔ Texas Rangers Globe Life Field ne Six Flags Over Texas, na ɛma region no mu nneɛma a ɛda adi no hyɛ suburban core baako mu.

Bɔɔl amammerɛ wɔ ha yɛ kakraa bi wɔ suburban Arlington mu sene sɛ ɛyɛ Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex a ɛhyɛ no ho. Region no wɔ MLS kuw FC Dallas a ɔwɔ Frisco, na ɛwɔ Hispanic ne Latin American nnipa kuw kɛseɛ a ɛrekorɔ a wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn ho wɔ Mexican ne South American ɔman kuw no mu. Akɔnnɔ a wɔwɔ ama bɔɔl a ɛfiri amanaman ntam no ama AT&T Stadium yɛ neutral host papa: beaeɛ no ato Concacaf Gold Cup akansie ne 2024 Copa América akansie pii, na ɛtwe nnipa bebree, na ɛma metroplex no da adi wɔ continental bɔɔl map no so.
